{{Top|leg}}
'''Danicla''' was a [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] who frequented the [[warehouse district]] of [[Tal'cara]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] colony [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]]. She was seen begging and [[thief/Legends|picking pockets]].<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

By [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]] she was mature and had some wealth. However she was addicted to the thrill of her her business, and kept dressing with grimy rags, sometimes pretending to be a poor Chadra-Fan child, and stealing or begging. Usually she picked the pockets of the victims who gave her alms.<ref name="guide" />

She was one of the few beings knowing the location of [[Torel Fey'jia]]'s [[Torel Fey'jia's Spynet Facility|Spynet facility]] under the city; whenever she found a [[Serranite/Legends|serranite]] on a victim's left side, she knew that the individual was a contact and had to be guided to the abandoned warehouse, serving as the facility's entrance.<ref name="guide" />
==Personality and traits==
Danicla was a mature Chandra-Fan female, under a [[meter/Legends|meter]] tall with a slight frame. She spoke rapidly with an annoying high pitch and could pass for a child when she wanted to. She used to wear form-fitting dark clothes, above which she wore her beggar disguise. When not working, she wore a lot of jewels and earrings on her many-pierced ears.<ref name="guide" />
